image_description: A full suit of polished steel plate armor, likely Gothic or Maximilian style, displayed against a dark red background. The image focuses on the torso, featuring a prominent breastplate with vertical fluting, attached pauldrons (shoulder armor), vambraces (arm armor), and faulds/tassets (waist/hip armor). The metal is highly reflective, showing distorted reflections of the environment.
